English: Prenatal exposure to maternal depression increases the risk for onset of emotional and behavioural disorders in children.

Yoruba: Ìṣàfihàn ajemóyún sí ìrẹ̀wẹ̀sì ìyá máa ń fa kí ewu fún ìbẹ̀rẹ̀pẹ̀pẹ̀ ìmọ̀lára àti ségesège nínú ìwà ọmọdé.
Zulu: Ukuchayeka ngaphambi kokubeletha ekucindezelekeni komama kwandisa ingozi yokuqala yezinkinga zemizwelo nezokuziphatha ezinganeni.
Hausa: Bayyana ga ciwon damuwa lokacin juna-biyu yana ƙara haɗarin fara wa na matsalolin motsin rai da kuma ɗabi’a a cikin yara.

English: Here, we investigated the effects of exposure to prenatal depression on white matter microstructural integrity at birth and at 2–3 years, and associated neurodevelopment.
Luganda: Wano, twanoonyereza ku bituusibwa omukazi okweraliikirira ng’ali lubuto eri obugumu bw’ekitundu ky’obwongo ekyeru mu kuzaalibwa ne ku myaka 2–3, awamu ne bye kituusa ku nkulaakulana y’obwongo.
Yoruba: Níbí, a ṣẹ ìwádìí lórí ipa ìṣàfihàn sí ìrẹ̀wẹ̀sì-ajẹmóyún ń kó lórí ajẹmọ́-ọpọlọ-tó-ń-ṣiṣẹ́-fún-gbígbà-ìmọ̀ ní ìkókó àti ní ọmọ ọdun 2-3, àti ìdàgbàsókò ọpọlọ tí ó so mọ́ ọ.
Zulu: Lapha, siphenye imiphumela yokuchayeka ekucindezelekeni kwangaphambi kokubeletha mayelana nobuqotho be-microstructural nto emhlophe ngesikhathi sokuzalwa kanye neminyaka engu-2-3, kanye ne-neurodevelopment ehambisanayo.
Hausa: A nan, mun bincika sakamakon bayyana ga ciwon damuwa kafin haihuwa a kan ingancin ɓangaren isar da saƙonni na ƙwaƙwalwa a lokacin haihuwa da kuma a cikin shekaru 2 zuwa 3, da kuma haɓakar da ta shafi ƙwaƙwala.
Northern Sotho: Mo, re nyakišiša diabe tša exposure go kgatelelo ya monagano pele ga pelego go ba le mabjoko a sebopego se sennyane sa mmala o mošweu ao a thušago tlhaologanyo nakong ya pelego le mengwaga ye 2–3, le kgolo ya monagano ye e amanago le ona.
Amharic: እዚህ፣ በወሊድ እና በ 2-3 ዓመታት ውስጥ፣ ለቅድመ ወሊድ ድብርት ተጋላጭነትን በአንጎል ነጭ ቁስ አካል ጥቃቅን መዋቅራዊ አንድነት እና፣ በነርቭ እድገት ላይ ያለውን ተጽእኖዎች መርምረናል።

English: Diffusion-weighted images were acquired for children of the Drakenstein Child Health Study at 2–4 weeks postpartum (n = 70, 47% boys) and at 2–3 years of age (n = 60, 58% boys).
Luganda: Ebifaananyi by’enkola y’obwongo byafunibwa eby’abaana ab’omu kunoonyereza kwa Drakenstein Child Health ku wiiki 2–4 oluvannyuma lw’okuzaalibwa (n = 70, 47% abalenzi) n’emyaka 2–3 egy’obukulu (n = 60, 58% abalenzi).
Yoruba: Wọn gba àwòrán ìtọ̀sán aṣàgbéyẹ̀wò fún àwọn ọmọ ti ó wà ní ọ̀sẹ̀ 2-4 lẹ́yìn ìbí ní Drakenstein Child Health Study ( n =70, àwọn ọkùnrin 47%) àti àwọn ọmọ tí ọjọ́ orí wọn jẹ́ ọmọ ọdun 2-3 (n =60, àwọn ọkùnrin 58%).
Zulu: Izithombe ezinesisindo esisabalele zatholelwa izingane Zocwaningo Lwezempilo Yengane yase-Drakenstein emavikini angu-2–4 ngemva kokubeletha (n = 70, 47% abafana) futhi eminyakeni engu-2–3 ubudala (n = 60, 58% abafana).
Hausa: An samo hotunan ƙwaƙwalwa na yara na Nazarin Kiwon Lafiyar Yara na Drakenstein a makonni 2 zuwa makonni 4 bayan haihuwa (yara maza n = 70, 47%) da kuma a shekaru 2 zuwa 3 (yara maza n = 60, 58%).
Northern Sotho: Diswantšho tša diphatlalatšo tše di kadilwego di hweditšwe go bana ba Drakenstein Child Health Study go dibeke tše 2–4 postpartum (n = 70, 47% bašemane) le mengwaga ye 2–3 (n = 60, 58% bašemane).
Amharic: ከ2-4 ሳምንታት ከወሊድ በኋላ (n = 70፣ 47% ወንዶች) እና ከ2-3 ዓመታት ዕድሜ (n = 60፣ 58% ወንዶች) ላይ ለድራከንስታይን የሕፃን ጤና ጥናት ልጆች የስርጭት ክብደት ያላቸው ምስሎች ተገኝተዋል።

English: Tract-Based Spatial Statistics was used to compare diffusion tensor metrics across groups defined by presence (> 19 on Beck’s Depression Inventory and/or > 12 on the Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale) or absence (below depression thresholds) of depression, and associations with neurodevelopmental measures at age 2–3 years were determined.
Luganda: Enkola ya Tract-Based Spatial Statistics yakozesebwa okugeraageranya entambula y’amazzi mu bwongo mu bibinja eby’abalina obweraliikirivu (> 19 ku Bibuuzo bya Beck Ebikwata ku Bweraliikirivu ne/oba > 12 ku lupimo lwa Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale) oba eby’abatalina (wansi w’essalira ly’obweraliikirivu), n’obukwatane n’ebipimo by’enkulaakulana y’obwongo ku myaka 2-3 byazuulibwa.
Yoruba: Ni wọ́n lò láti ṣàfiwéra ìwọ̀n mólékù inú omi kárí gbogbo ọ̀wọ́ nípa wíwà (> 19 lórí Ààtò Ìwọ̀n Beck àti/tàbí > 12 lórí Ìwọ̀n Ìrẹ̀wẹ̀sì Ẹ̀yìn Ìbímọ ti Edinburgh) tàbí àìsí (àìdétẹ̀wọ̀n tó ìpele ìrẹ̀wẹ̀sì) ti ìrẹ̀wẹ̀sì, àti ìbáṣe pẹlú ̀wọn ìṣòdiwọ̀n í ó jẹmọ́ ìdàgbàsókè ọpọ̀lọ ní wọ́n fi múlẹ̀ láàrin àwọn tí wọ́n wà ní ọjọ́-orí 2-3.
Zulu: Izibalo Zendawo Ezisekelwe Kupheshana zisetshenziswe ukuqhathanisa amamethrikhi ethayo yokusabalalisa kuwo wonke amaqembu achazwe ngokuba khona (> 19 ku-Beck's Depression Inventory kanye/noma > 12 Esikalini Sokucindezeleka Kwangemva Kokubeletha E-Edinburgh) noma ukungabikho (ngaphansi kwemikhawulo yokucindezeleka) kokucindezeleka, kanye nezinhlangano ne-neurodevelopmental. izilinganiso eminyakeni engu-2-3 zinqunywa.
Hausa: An yi amfani da Ƙididdigar Kimanta Ƙwaƙwalwa domin kwatanta hotunan ƙwaƙwalwa a tsakanin rukunoni ta bayyana ta kasancewar (> 19 a kan Yawan Damuwa na Beck da kuma/ko > 12 a kan Ma’aunin Bincika Damuwa Bayan Haihuwa na Edinburgh) ko an ƙaddara rashi (ƙasa da mafarin damuwa) na damuwa, da alaƙa tare da matakan haɓakar ƙwaƙwalwa a cikin shekaru 2 zuwa shekaru 3.
Northern Sotho: Go šomišitšwe Tract-Based Spatial Statistics go bapetša dimetheriki tša thensa ya phatlalatšo go kgabaganya dihlopha tše di hlalošwago ka go ba gona (> 19 go Beck’s Depression Inventory le/goba > 12 ka go Sekala sa Kgatelelo ya monagano ya Morago ga Pelego ya Edinburgh) goba go hlokagala (ka fase ga ditekanyetšo tša kgatelelo ya monagano) ga kgatelelo ya monagano, le dikamano le magato a kgolo ya monagano go mengwaga ye 2–3 di laeditšwe.
Amharic: በትንሽ ስፍራ ላይ የተመሰረተ ስታቲስቲክስ መኖር በተገለጹት ቡድኖች ውስጥ የስርጭት ቴንሰር መለኪያዎችን ለማነፃፀር ጥቅም ላይ ውሏል (> 19 የቤክ የድብርት ዝርዝር እና/ወይም > 12 በኤድንብራ ድህረ ወሊድ ድብርት ሚዛን) ወይም መቅረት (ከድብርት ደረጃዎች በታች) የድብርት እና ከነርቭ እድገት ጋር ያሉ ትስስሮች ከ2-3 አመት እድሜ ያላቸው እርምጃዎች ተወስነዋል።

English: We did not detect group differences in white matter integrity at neonatal age in this cohort, but at 2–3 years, children in the exposed group demonstrated higher fractional anisotropy, and lower mean and radial diffusivity in association tracts compared to control children.
Luganda: Tetwafuna njawukana mu bibinja mu buyuŋŋane bw’ekitundu ky’obwongo ekyeru ku kiseera ky’okuzaalibwa mu kibinja kino, naye ku myaka 2–3, abaana b’abakazi abaalina obweraliikirivu baalina obwongo obutayungiddwa bulungi, n’omukkati ogwa wansi mu buguwa bw’omu bwongo bw’ogeraageranya n’abaana abegeraageranyizibwako.
Yoruba: A kò rí ìyàtọ̀ nínú ẹgbé tó wà nínú ajẹmọ́-ọpọlọ-tó-ń-ṣiṣẹ́-fún-gbígba-ìmọ̀ ni ọjọ́ orí ìkókó nínú ọ̀wọ́ yìí, ṣùgbọ́n ní ọmọ ọdun 2-3, àwọn ọmọ tó wà ní ọ̀wọ́ tí ó gbà láàyè ṣe àfihàn ìfòdo-feni-ṣèwọ̀n, àti ìfiye-dákòó tí kò tẹ̀wọ̀n àti  àpòpọ̀ omi ní àfiwéra pẹ̀lú àwọn ọmọ tí wọ́n ń rí ìdarí.
Zulu: Asizange sithole umehluko weqembu ekuthembekeni kwezindaba ezimhlophe eminyakeni yobudala esanda kuzalwa kuleli qoqo, kodwa eminyakeni engu-2-3, izingane eziseqenjini eliveziwe zabonisa i-anisotropy ye-fractional ephakeme, kanye nencazelo ephansi kanye ne-radial diffusivity kumapheshana okuhlanganisa uma kuqhathaniswa nokulawula izingane.
Hausa: Ba mu gano bambance-bambancen rukuni ba a cikin ingancin ɓangaren isar da saƙonni na ƙwaƙwalwa a shekarar yarinta a cikin wannan rukunin, amma a cikin shekaru 2 zuwa 3, yaran a cikin rukunin da suka bayyana sun nuna ƙimar ƙididdigar ƙwaƙwalwa mafi girma, da ƙaramin matsakaici da ƙimar gudanar ruwa a cikin hanyoyin haɗa ɓangarorin ƙwaƙwalwa guda biyu idan aka kwatanta da yara da ake kulawa.
Northern Sotho: Ga se ra lemoga diphapano tša dihlopha go mabjoko a mmala o mošweu ao a thušago tlhaologanyo go masea ao a sa tšwago go belegwa ka sehlopheng se, eupša go mengwaya ye 2–3, bana go sehlopha sa go ba lebanego le bothata bjo ba bontšhitše anisotherofi ya go ba le dikgaogao ya godimo, le palogare ya fase le diphatlalatšo ya radiale go dithereke tša kamano ge go bapetšwa le taolo ya bana.
Amharic: በዚህ ተጠኝ ውስጥ በአራስ ጊዜ እድሜ ውስጥ የቡድን ልዩነቶችን በአንጎል ነጭ ቁስ አካል አንድነነት ውስጥ አላገኘንም፣ ግን ከ2-3 ዓመታት ውስጥ፣ በተጋላጭ ቡድን ውስጥ ያሉ ልጆች ከፍተኛ በአንጎል ውስጥ የውሃ መጠን ዝውውር፣ እና ዝቅተኛ አማካይ እና ራዲያል ስርጭትን በማህበር ትራክቶች ውስጥ ከቁጥጥር ልጆች ጋር ሲነፃፀሩ አሳይተዋል።

English: This was notable in the sagittal stratum (radial diffusivity: p < 0.01).
Luganda: Kino kyalabibwa mu kitundu kya sagittal stratum (radial diffusivity: p < 0.01).
Yoruba: Èyí fara hàn nínú iwájú ọpọ̀lọ (àpòpọ̀ omi: p < 0.01).
Zulu: Lokhu bekuphawuleka ku-sagittal stratum (i-radial diffusivity: p < 0.01).
Hausa: Wannan sananne ne a cikin farin yankin ɓangaren ƙwaƙwalwa (ƙimar watsuwar ruwa: p  < 0.01).
Northern Sotho: Se se lemogilwe ka go sagittal stratum (radial diffusivity: p < 0.01).
Amharic: ይህ በሳጊታል ሽንሽን (የራዲያል ስርጭት: p < 0.01) ውስጥ ጎልቶ የሚታይ ነበር።

English: Altered white matter integrity metrics were also observed in projection tracts, including the corona radiata, which associated with cognitive and motor outcomes in exposed 2-3-year-olds (p < 0.05).
Luganda: Obuyuŋŋane bw’ekitundu ky’obwongo ekyeru obukyusiddwa bwalabibwa mu buwuzi obuyitibwa projection tracts, omuli corona radiata, nga kino kyali kikwanyizibwa n’entegeera mu baana ab’emyaka 2-3 abaazaalibwa abakazi abaalina obweraliikirivu (p < 0.05).
Yoruba: Àwọn ìwọ̀n ajẹmọ́-ọpọlọ-tó-ń-ṣiṣẹ́-fún-gbígba-ìmọ̀ tí wọ́n ti dàrú náà ṣe àkíyèsí nínú òpó ìgasókè, èyí tí ó ní ìbáṣe pẹ̀lú ajẹmóye àti àyípadà ìmọ̀ọ́nṣe nínú àwọn ẹni ọdún 2-3 tí ò láàbò (p < 0.05).
Zulu: Amamethrikhi ashintshiwe obuqotho bento emhlophe nawo abonwa kumapheshana okuqagela, okuhlanganisa i-corona radiata, ehlotshaniswa nemiphumela yengqondo nemoto kubantwana abaneminyaka engu-2-3 ubudala (p < 0.05) obala.
Hausa: An kuma lura da ma'auni ingancin ɓangaren isar da saƙonni na ƙwaƙwalwa da ya canza a cikin hanyoyin da suka haɗa ƙwaƙwalwa da laka, gami da jijiyoyin ƙwaƙwalwa, waɗanda suke da alaƙa da fahimi da sakamakon tafiyar da motsi na ƙwaƙwalwa a cikin yara ‘yan shekaru 2 zuwa 3 da aka bayyanar (p  < 0.05).
Northern Sotho: Dimethriki tša mabjoko a mmala o mošweu ao a thušago tlhaologanyo tše di fetotšwego le tšona di lemogilwe go tracts tša kakanyo, go akaretša corona radiata, yeo ge e amantšhwa le dipoelo tša tšhomišo ya tlhaologanyo le ditho tša mmele go bana ba mengwaga ye 2-3 bao ba lebanego le bothata (p < 0.05).
Amharic: ከ2-3-አመት እድሜ ያላቸው (p < 0.05) ከእውቀት እና ከእንቅስቃሴ ውጤቶች ጋር የተያያዘውን ኮሮና ራዲታን ጨምሮ፣ በፕሮጀክሽን ትራክቶች ላይ የተለወጡ የአንጎል ነጭ ቁስ አካል አንድነት መለኪያዎችም ተስተውለዋል (p < 0.01))።

English: Our findings of widespread white matter alterations in 2-3-year-old children with prenatal exposure to depression are consistent with previous findings, as well as with neuroimaging findings in adults with major depression.
Luganda: Bye twazuula ku kukyukyuka mu kitundu ky’obwongo ekyeru mu baana ab’emyaka 2-3 abaazaalibwa abakazi abalina obweraliikirivu bikwatagana n’ebyazuulibwa edda, awamu n’ebyazuulibwa mu kukuba ebifaananyi by’obwongo mu bantu abakulu abalina obweraliikirivu obw’amaanyi.

English: The researchers followed-up with the women again after they delivered their babies, and took detailed pictures, or brain scans, of their babies’ brains when they were 2-4 weeks old, and again at 2–3 years.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baddamu okulondoola abakazi bano nga bamaze okuzaala abaana baabwe, ne babakuba ebifaananyi, oba okukola sikaani z’obwongo, ez’obwongo bw’abaana baabwe nga ba myezi 2-4, n’oluvannyuma nga bawezezza emyaka 2-3.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí tọpinpin àwọn obìnrin yìí lẹ́yìn ti wọ́n bímọ, wọ́n ya àwòrán fínífíní, tàbí àwòrán ọpọlọ, ti ọpọlọ àwọn ọmọ wọn nígbà tí wọ́n wà ní ọ̀sẹ̀ 2-4, àti ní ìgbà tí wọ́n wà ní ọmọ ọdún 2-3.
Zulu: Abacwaningi balandelana nalaba besifazane futhi ngemva kokubeletha izingane zabo, futhi bathatha izithombe ezinemininingwane, noma izikena zobuchopho, zobuchopho bezingane zabo lapho zinamasonto angu-2-4 ubudala, futhi futhi eminyakeni engu-2-3.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun sake bibiyar matan bayan sun haifi jariransu, kuma sun ɗauki cikakkun hotuna, ko duban ƙwaƙwalwa, na ƙwaƙwalwar jariransu a lokacin da suke da makonni 2 zuwa 4, da kuma a shekaru 2 zuwa 3.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lekotše seemo sa basadi gape morago ga gore ba belege masea a bona, le go tšea diswantšho tše di tseneletšego, goba disekena tša bjoko, tša mabjoko a masea a bona ge ba be ba na le dibeke tše 2-4, le mo mengwageng ye 2–3.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ሴቶቹ ልጆቻቸውን ከወለዱ በኋላ እንደገና ተከታትለዋቸዋል፣ እና ከ2-4 ሳምንታት እድሜያቸው እና ከ2-3 አመት ውስጥ የልጆቻቸውን አእምሮ ዝርዝር ምስሎችን፣ ወይም የአዕምሮ ቅኝቶችን ወስደዋል።

English: The researchers split the women into 2 groups:
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baayawula mu bakazi ebibinja 2:
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí pín àwọn obìnrin náà sí ẹgbẹ́ méjì:

English: those who were depressed and those who were not.
Luganda: abo abaalina obweraliikirivu n’abataalina bweraliikirivu.
Yoruba: àwọn tí wọ́n ní ìrèwẹ̀sì ọkàn àti àwọn tih kò ní.
Zulu: ababecindezelekile nalabo ababengacindezelekile.
Hausa: waɗanda suke cikin damuwa da waɗanda ba sa ciki.
Northern Sotho: bao ba bego ba na le kgatelelo ya monagano le bao ba bego ba se na kgatelelo ya monagano.
Amharic: ተደብረው የነበሩ እና ያልተደበሩት።

English: They reported that children’s weights in both groups were similar at each time point.
Luganda: Baalaga nti obuzito bw’abaana mu bibinja byombi bwali bwenkana mu buli kiseera.
Yoruba: Wọ́n jábọ̀ pé ìwúwo àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ méjéèjì jọra ní ìgbà kugbà.
Zulu: Babika ukuthi izisindo zezingane kuwo womabili amaqembu zazifana ngesikhathi ngasinye.
Hausa: Sun bayar da rahoton cewa nauyin yara a cikin duka rukunonin biyu sun kasance daidai a kowane lokaci.
Northern Sotho: Ba begile gore boima bja bana ka dihlopheng ka bobedi di be di swana dinakong ka moka.
Amharic: በሁለቱም ቡድኖች ውስጥ ያሉ የልጆች ክብደቶች በእያንዳንዱ ጊዜ ተመሳሳይ መሆናቸውን ዘግበዋል።

English: However, at 2-3 weeks, children born to depressed women had smaller heads and were shorter than those born to non-depressed women.
Luganda: Wabula, ku wiiki 2-3, abaana ba bamaama abaalina obweraliikirivu baalina emitwe mitono era baali bampi okusinga ku abo ab’abakazi abataalina bweraliikirivu.
Yoruba: Ṣùgbọ́n, ní ọ̀sẹ̀ 2-3, àwọn obìnrin tó ní ìrẹ̀wẹ̀sì ọkàn máa ń bí àwọn ọmọ tí orí wọn kéré tí wọ́n sì kúrú ju àwọn ọmọ tí àwọn obìnrin tí kò ní ìrẹ̀wẹ̀sì ọkan máa ń bí lọ.
Zulu: Kodwa-ke, emavikini angu-2-3, izingane ezizalwa ngabesifazane abacindezelekile zazinamakhanda amancane futhi zifushane kunalabo abazalwa ngabesifazane abangacindezelekile.
Hausa: Duk da haka, a cikin makonni 2 zuwa 3, yaran da mata da suke cikin damuwa suka haifa suna da ƙananan kawuna kuma sun fi gajarta fiye da waɗanda mata da ba sa cikin damuwa suka haifa.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, go dibeke tše 2-3, bana ba belegwego ke basadi bao ba nago le kgatelelo ya monagano ba bile le dihlogo tše nnyane le go ba ba bakopana ge ba bapetšwa le bao ba belegwego ka basadi bao ba se nago kgatelelo ya monagano.
Amharic: ነገር ግን፣ በ2-3 ሳምንታት ውስጥ፣ በተደበሩ ሴቶች የተወለዱ ልጆች ትንሽ ጭንቅላት ያላቸው እና ባልተደበሩ ሴቶች ከተወለዱት ያጥሩ ናቸው።

English: The researchers also said women who were depressed tended to drink alcohol and smoked tobacco more than those who did not have stress.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baagamba nti abakazi abaalina obweraliikirivu baateranga okunywa omwenge n’okufuuwa taaba okusinga ku abo abataalina bweraliikirivu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí tún sọ pé àwọn obìnrin tí wọ́n ní ìrẹ̀wẹ̀sì ọkàn máa n sábà mú ọtí, wọ́n sì máa n fa sìgá ju àwọn tí kò ní wàhálà lọ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde bathi abesifazane abacindezelekile bajwayele ukuphuza utshwala futhi babheme ugwayi ngaphezu kwalabo abangenaso ingcindezi.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma ce matan da suke cikin damuwa sun fi son shan barasa da shan taba fiye da waɗanda ba sa cikin damuwa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše le gore basadi bao bilego le kgatelelo ya monagano ba be ba enwa bjala le go kgoga motsoko go feta bao ba bego ba se na le kgatelelo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የተደበሩ ሴቶች ድብርት ከሌላቸው በበለጠ አልኮል ለመጠጣትና ትንባሆ ለማጨስ ይነሳሳሉ ብለዋል።

English: Then the doctors analysed the children’s brain scans, they did not find any difference between the 2 groups at 2-3 weeks.
Luganda: Abasawo bwe beetegereza sikaani z’obwongo bw’abaana, tebaazuula njawulo yonna wakati w’ebibinja 2 ku wiiki 2-3.
Yoruba: Nígbà tí àwọn ọníṣègùn òyìnbó ṣe ìtúpalẹ̀ àwòrán ọpọlọ ọmọdé, wọn kò rí ìyàtọ̀ láàárín àwọn ọ̀wọ́ méjéèjì ní ọ̀sẹ̀ 2-3.
Zulu: Lapho odokotela behlaziya ukuhlolwa kobuchopho bezingane, abatholanga umehluko phakathi kwamaqembu ama-2 kumaviki angu-2-3.
Hausa: Lokacin da likitocin suka yi nazarin binciken ƙwaƙwalwar yara, ba su sami wani bambanci a tsakanin rukunonin 2 a makonni 2 zuwa 3 ba.
Northern Sotho: Ge dingaka di be di sekaseka disekene tša mabjoko a bana, ga se ba lemoga phapano efe goba efe magareng ga dihlopha tše 2 go dibeke tše 2-3.
Amharic: ዶክተሮቹ የልጆቹን የአንጎል ምርመራዎች ሲተነትኑ፣ ከ2-3 ሳምንታት ውስጥ በ2ቱ ቡድኖች መካከል ምንም ልዩነት አላገኙም።

English: However, after 2-3 years, researchers found that brains of children born to stressed women were not well connected and had been affected.
Luganda: Wabula, oluvannyuma lw’emyaka 2-3, abanoonyereza baakizuula nti obwongo bw’abaana abazaalibwa abakazi abaalina obweraliikirivu bwali tebwegasse bulungi era bwali bukoseddwa.
Yoruba: Ṣùgbọ́n, lẹ́yìn ọdún 2-3, àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe àwárí pé, àwọn obìnrin tí wọ́n máa ń ṣe wàhálà máa n bi ọmọ tí wàhálà yìí ti nípa lórí ọpọlọ wọn, ọpọlọ àwọn ọmọ náà kì í ní àsopọ̀ tó dáadáa.
Zulu: Kodwa-ke, ngemva kweminyaka engu-2-3, abacwaningi bathola ukuthi ubuchopho bezingane ezizalwa ngabesifazane abacindezelekile babungaxhumene kahle futhi babuthintekile.
Hausa: Duk da haka, bayan shekaru 2 zuwa 3, masu binciken sun gano cewa ƙwaƙwalwar yaran da matan da suke cikin damuwa suka haifa ba su da alaƙa da juna sosai kuma ya shafe su.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, morago ga mengwaga ye 2-3, banyakišiši ba hweditše gore mabjoko a bana ba go belegwa ke basadi bao ba nago le kgatelelo ya monagano a be a sa sware gabotse le gona a bile le kamego.
Amharic: ይሁን እንጂ፣ ከ2-3 ዓመታት በኋላ ተመራማሪዎች በውጥረት በተደበሩ ሴቶች የተወለዱ ሕፃናት አእምሮ በደንብ ያልተገናኘ እና የተጎዳ መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል።

English: The connections between brain cells, or neurons, can be a measure of intelligence, language ability and memory, so children with brains that are not well connected may have problems in these areas.
Luganda: Obuyuŋŋane bw’obutaffaali bw’obwongo busobola okupimirwako okutegeera, obusobozi bw’olulimi n’okujjukira, noolwekyo abaana abalina obwongo obutayungiddwa bulungi bayinza okuba n’obuzibu mu nsonga zino.
Yoruba: Asopọ̀ tó wà láàárín àwọn hóró ọpọlọ, tàbí ajẹmọ́ ọpọlọ, lè jẹ́ òdiwọ̀n fún ìjáfáfá, òye èdè àti ọpọlọ pípé, fún ìdí èyí, àwọn ọmọdé tí ọpọlọ wọn kò ní àsopọ̀ tó dára lè ní ìṣòrọ nị àwọn àgbègbè yìí.
Zulu: Ukuxhumana phakathi kwamangqamuzana obuchopho, noma ama-neurons, kungaba isilinganiso sobuhlakani, ikhono lolimi nenkumbulo, ngakho izingane ezinobuchopho obungaxhumekile kahle zingase zibe nezinkinga kulezi zindawo.
Hausa: Alaƙa a tsakanin sel-sel na ƙwaƙwalwa, tana iya zama ma’auni na hazaƙa da iya harshe da kuma harda, domin haka yaran da suke da ƙwaƙwalwar da ba ta da alaƙa da kyau suna iya samun matsala a waɗannan wuraren.
Northern Sotho: Dikgokagano magareng ga disele tša mabjoko, goba dinyurone, e ka ba kelo ya bohlale, bokgoni bja polelo le kelelo, ka gona bana ba mabjoko ao a sa swarego gabotse ba ka ba le mathata ka ditikologong tše.
Amharic: በአንጎል ህዋሳት፣ ወይም በነርቭ ህዋሳት፣ መካከል ያለው ግንኙነት የማሰብ ችሎታ፣ የቋንቋ ችሎታ እና የማስታወስ ችሎታ መለኪያ ሊሆን ይችላል፣ ስለዚህ በደንብ ያልተገናኘ አእምሮ ያላቸው ልጆች በነዚህ ቦታዎች ላይ ችግር ሊገጥማቸው ይችላል።

English: The researchers said they found that the part of the child’s brain called the ‘sagittal stratum’, was most affected when the child’s mother was stressed during pregnancy.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti baakisanga nga ekitundu ky’obwongo bw’omwana ekiyitibwa ‘sagittal stratum’, kyasinga okukosebwa nga maama w’omwana yalina obweraliikirivu ng’ali lubuto.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé wọ́n ṣe àwárí apá kan nínú ọpọlọ ọmọdé tí ó jẹ́ ‘Iwájú ọpọlọ’ tí ìyá bá ṣe ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ wàhálà lásìkò tó wà nínú oyún, ó máa ní ipa lórí rẹ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi bathole ukuthi ingxenye yobuchopho bengane ebizwa ngokuthi ‘sagittal stratum’, ithinteke kakhulu lapho umama wengane ecindezelekile ngesikhathi ekhulelwe.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce sun gano cewa ɓangaren ƙwaƙwalwar yaron da ake kira ‘farin yankin ɓangaren ƙwaƙwalwa’, ya fi shafa a lokacin da mahaifiyar yaron ta shiga cikin damuwa a lokacin juna-biyu.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore ba lemogile gore karolo ya bjoko bja ngwana ye e bitšwago ‘sagittal stratum’, e amegile kudu ge mmago ngwana a be a gatelegile kudu nakong ya boimana.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በልጁ እናት በእርግዝና ወቅት ጭንቀት በሚፈጠርበት ጊዜ "ሳጊታል ሽንሽን" ተብሎ የሚጠራው፣ በጣም የተጎዳው የአዕምሮ ክፍል መሆኑን ደርሰውበታል።

English: ‘Sagittal stratum’ is the front part of the brain and has many fibres.
Luganda: ‘Sagittal stratum’kye kitundu ky’obwongo eky’omu maaso era kirina obuguwa bungi.
Yoruba: ‘Iwájú ọpọlọ’ jẹ́ apá iwájú ọpọlọ tó ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ fíbà.
Zulu: ‘I-Sagittal stratum’ ingxenye engaphambili yobuchopho futhi inemicu eminingi.
Hausa: 'Farain Yankin ɓangaren ƙwaƙwalwa' shi ne sashin gaba na ƙwaƙwalwa kuma yana da silolin halitta da yawa.
Northern Sotho: ‘Sagittal stratum’ ke karolo ya ka pele ya bjoko le gona e na le difaepa tše ntši.
Amharic: 'ሳጊታል ሽንሽን' የአዕምሮ የፊት ክፍል ሲሆን ብዙ ድሮች አሉት።

English: Fibres are long and thin thread-like structures of the brain.
Luganda: Obuguwa buno buba buwanvu ate nga butini mu bwongo.
Yoruba: Fíbà jẹ́ ohun tí ó gùn tí ó sì tíírí bí okùn nínú ọpọlọ.
Zulu: Imicu yizinhlaka ezinde nezincane ezifana nentambo yobuchopho.
Hausa: Silolin halitta dogaye ne kuma sirara kamar siffofin ƙwaƙwalwa.
Northern Sotho: Difaeba ke dibopego tše telele le tšeo o ka rego ke lešira la bjoko.
Amharic: ድሮች ረዣዥም እና ቀጭን ክር-መሳይ የአንጎል መዋቅሮች ናቸው።

English: The researchers said their study was the first to give evidence of how depression in pregnant women could affect the brains of their children.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti okunoonyereza kwabwe kwe kwasooka okulaga obukakafu ku ngeri obweraliikirivu mu bakazi abali embuto gye busobola okukosa obwonga bw’abaana baabwe.
Yoruba: Àwọn asẹ̀wádìí sọ pé iṣẹ́ ìwádìí wọn ló kọ́kọ́ mú èrí bí ìrẹ̀wẹ̀sì nínú aláboyún ṣe máa ń ní ipa lórí ọmọ wọn wá.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathe ucwaningo lwabo belungowokuqala ukunikeza ubufakazi bokuthi ingcindezi kwabesifazane abakhulelwe ingabathinta kanjani ubuchopho bezingane zabo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce binciken da suka yi shi ne na farko da ya bayar da shaida a kan yadda kasancewa cikin damuwa ga mata masu juna-biyu yake shafar ƙwaƙwalwar ’ya’yansu.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore dinyakišišo tša bona e bile tša mathomo go fana ka bohlatse bja ka moo kgatelelo ya monagano go basadi ba baimana e ka amago mabjoko a bana ba bona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ጥናታቸው በነፍሰ ጡር እናቶች ላይ የሚደርሰው ድብርት የልጆቻቸውን አእምሮ እንዴት እንደሚጎዳ ማስረጃ ያሳየ የመጀመሪያው ነው ብለዋል።

English: They however said some other factors which they did not measure might have affected the babies’ brain development or their behaviour at a later stage.
Luganda: Wabula baagamba nti ensonga endala ezimu ze bateekenneenya ziyinza okuba nga zaakosa enkulaakulana y’obwongo bw’abaana oba enneeyisa yaabwe mu biseera eby’omu maaso.
